entries.ending.luz.title: The light returns to the bay
entries.ending.luz.body: Lupa's sea glass cuts through the fog like a golden thread. A slow boat sails into the harbour, and Tomé cries a little and says it's the salt.
entries.ending.campana.title: A bell in the fog
entries.ending.campana.body: The bell rings until your arms ache. The boats follow the sound, one by one, and Brisa Baja falls asleep at ease.
